_doc: Classified allowlist for tests/test_numeric_lint.py - the executable
no-magic-number invariant. Every non-trivial numeric literal in
src/**/*.py must appear here (per file) with a class from the
validation/dof_audit.md taxonomy and a one-line provenance note, or
live inside an exempted, classified data-block/function.
Classes: SPEC (declared given), MODEL-CONST (defines the cited model),
EMPIRICAL (literature correlation w/ band), NUMERIC (solver/grid knob
with a convergence or cross check). Trivial structural literals
